umbrella_agency.quote: There is created within the department the Board of Optometry

degree_required.quote: Has graduated from an accredited school or college of optometry approved by rule of the board

accrediting_body.quote: Has graduated from an accredited school or college of optometry approved by rule of the board

kind.quote: Has completed at least 1 year of supervised experience in differential diagnosis of eye disease or disorders

exams.name: Licensure examination
exams.quote: The board shall approve a licensure examination consisting of the appropriate subjects and including applicable state laws and rules and general and ocular pharmacology

interval_years.quote: The department shall renew a license upon receipt of the renewal application and the fee set by the board not to exceed $300

renewal_fee_usd.quote: the fee set by the board not to exceed $300

required.quote: As a condition of license renewal, a licensee must demonstrate his or her professional competence by completing up to 30 hours of continuing education during the 2-year period preceding license renewal

hours_per_period.quote: completing up to 30 hours of continuing education during the 2-year period preceding license renewal

period_years.quote: during the 2-year period preceding license renewal

value: 6 or more hours of approved transcript-quality coursework in ocular and systemic pharmacology and the diagnosis, treatment, and management of ocular and systemic conditions and diseases
topical_requirements.quote: For certified optometrists, the 30-hour continuing education requirement includes 6 or more hours of approved transcript-quality coursework in ocular and systemic pharmacology and the diagnosis, treatment, and management of ocular and systemic conditions and diseases during the 2-year period preceding application for license renewal

available.quote: In order to ensure that licensed practitioners may be considered for licensure in other states, the board may enter into reciprocity agreements with other states

exists.quote: There is created within the department the Board of Optometry, composed of seven members appointed by the Governor and confirmed by the Senate

regulatory_model.quote: Any person desiring to be a licensed practitioner under this chapter must apply to the department

credential_type.quote: Any person desiring to be a licensed practitioner under this chapter must apply to the department, submit to background screening in accordance with s. 456.0135, and submit proof to the department that she or he meets all of the following criteria

is_mandatory.quote: The sole legislative purpose in enacting this chapter is to ensure that every person engaged in the practice of optometry in this state meets minimum requirements for safe practice. It is the legislative intent that such persons who fall below minimum standards or who otherwise present a danger to the public shall be prohibited from practicing in this state

title_protection.quote: Identifying one's activity by using the name or title 'optometrist,' 'licensed practitioner,' 'certified optometrist,' 'Doctor of Optometry,' or 'O.D.' in a manner which represents to the public that the person is a licensed practitioner or certified optometrist when the person has not been licensed or certified pursuant to this chapter

scope_protection.quote: No person other than a licensed practitioner may engage in the practice of optometry as defined in s. 463.002(7)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procuring or attempting to procure a license by bribery, fraudulent misrepresentation, or through an error of the department or board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Procuring, or attempting to procure, a license to practice optometry by bribery, by fraudulent misrepresentations, or through an error of the department or board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against in another jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a license to practice optometry revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against, including the denial of licensure, by the licensing authority of another jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted or found guilty of a crime that directly relates to the practice of optometry or ability to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted or found guilty, regardless of adjudication, of a crime in any jurisdiction which directly relates to the practice of optometry or to the ability to practice optometry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or filing a report known to be false, intentionally or negligently failing to file required reports, or willfully impeding filing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or filing a report or record which the licensee knows to be false, intentionally or negligently failing to file a report or record required by state or federal law, willfully impeding or obstructing such filing, or inducing another person to do so

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising goods or services in a fraudulent, false, deceptive, or misleading manner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising goods or services in a manner which is fraudulent, false, deceptive, or misleading in form or content

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, deceit, negligence, incompetency, or misconduct in the practice of optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or deceit, negligence or incompetency, or misconduct in the practice of optometry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation or repeated violations of provisions of the optometry chapter or chapter 456 and any rules promulgated
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation or repeated violations of provisions of this chapter, or of chapter 456, and any rules promulgated pursuant thereto

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conspiring with another licensee or person to coerce, intimidate, or preclude another licensee from lawfully advertising services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conspiring with another licensee or with any person to commit an act, or committing an act, which would coerce, intimidate, or preclude another licensee from lawfully advertising her or his services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully submitting to a third-party payor a claim for services not provided to a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully submitting to any third-party payor a claim for services which were not provided to a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to keep written optometric records about examinations, treatments, and prescriptions for patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to keep written optometric records about the examinations, treatments, and prescriptions for patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully failing to report any person known to be in violation of optometry law or rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully failing to report any person who the licensee knows is in violation of this chapter or of rules of the department or the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing with a revoked, suspended, inactive, or delinquent license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing with a revoked, suspended, inactive, or delinquent license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being unable to practice optometry with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, substance abuse, or mental/physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being unable to practice optometry with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness or use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or any other type of material or as a result of any mental or physical condition

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having been disciplined by a regulatory agency in another state for an offense that would violate Florida optometry laws or rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having been disciplined by a regulatory agency in another state for any offense that would constitute a violation of Florida laws or rules regulating optometry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of section 463.014 or 463.015
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any provision of s. 463.014 or s. 463.015

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any lawful order of the board or department, or failing to comply with a lawfully issued subpoena
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any lawful order of the board or department, previously entered in a disciplinary hearing, or failing to comply with a lawfully issued subpoena of the board or department

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or offering to practice beyond the scope permitted by law or accepting professional responsibilities the licensee is not competent to perform
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing or offering to practice beyond the scope permitted by law or accepting and performing professional responsibilities which the licensee knows or has reason to know she or he is not competent to perform

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of chapter 456 or any rules adopted pursuant thereto
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any provision of this chapter or chapter 456, or any rules adopted pursuant thereto

definition_quote.value: the diagnosis of conditions of the human eye and its appendages; the employment of any objective or subjective means or methods, including the administration of ocular pharmaceutical agents, for the purpose of determining the refractive powers of the human eyes, or any visual, muscular, neurological, or anatomic anomalies of the human eyes and their appendages; and the prescribing and employment of lenses, prisms, frames, mountings, contact lenses, orthoptic exercises, light frequencies, and any other means or methods, including ocular pharmaceutical agents, for the correction, remedy, or relief of any insufficiencies or abnormal conditions of the human eyes and their appendages
definition_quote.quote: Optometry means the diagnosis of conditions of the human eye and its appendages; the employment of any objective or subjective means or methods, including the administration of ocular pharmaceutical agents, for the purpose of determining the refractive powers of the human eyes, or any visual, muscular, neurological, or anatomic anomalies of the human eyes and their appendages; and the prescribing and employment of lenses, prisms, frames, mountings, contact lenses, orthoptic exercises, light frequencies, and any other means or methods, including ocular pharmaceutical agents, for the correction, remedy, or relief of any insufficiencies or abnormal conditions of the human eyes and their appendages

value: objective or subjective means or methods
prescribing and employment of lenses, prisms, frames, mountings, contact lenses
methods_authorized.quote: the diagnosis of conditions of the human eye and its appendages; the employment of any objective or subjective means or methods, including the administration of ocular pharmaceutical agents, for the purpose of determining the refractive powers of the human eyes, or any visual, muscular, neurological, or anatomic anomalies of the human eyes and their appendages; and the prescribing and employment of lenses, prisms, frames, mountings, contact lenses, orthoptic exercises, light frequencies, and any other means or methods, including ocular pharmaceutical agents

drug_authority.value: Certified optometrists may administer and prescribe ocular pharmaceutical agents as provided in section 463.0055
drug_authority.quote: Certified optometrists may administer and prescribe ocular pharmaceutical agents as provided in this section for the diagnosis and treatment of ocular conditions of the human eye and its appendages without the use of surgery or other invasive techniques

surgery_prohibited.quote: Surgery of any kind is expressly prohibited

surgery_definition.value: a procedure using an instrument, including a laser, scalpel, or needle, in which human tissue is cut, burned, scraped except as provided in s. 463.014(4), or vaporized, by incision, injection, ultrasound, laser, infusion, cryotherapy, or radiation. The term includes a procedure using an instrument which requires the closure of human tissue by suture, clamp, or other such device
surgery_definition.quote: Surgery means a procedure using an instrument, including a laser, scalpel, or needle, in which human tissue is cut, burned, scraped except as provided in s. 463.014(4), or vaporized, by incision, injection, ultrasound, laser, infusion, cryotherapy, or radiation. The term includes a procedure using an instrument which requires the closure of human tissue by suture, clamp, or other such device

foreign_body_removal_authorized.quote: Certified optometrists may remove superficial foreign bodies. For the purposes of this subsection, the term 'superficial foreign bodies' means any foreign matter that is embedded in the conjunctiva or cornea but that has not penetrated the globe

value: probing an uninflamed tear duct in a patient 18 years of age or older
superficial scraping for the purpose of removing damaged epithelial tissue or superficial foreign bodies
taking a culture of the surface of the cornea or conjunctiva
minor_surgical_procedures_authorized.quote: a certified optometrist is not prohibited from providing any optometric care within the practice of optometry as defined in s. 463.002(7), such as removing an eyelash by epilation, probing an uninflamed tear duct in a patient 18 years of age or older, blocking the puncta by plug, or superficial scraping for the purpose of removing damaged epithelial tissue or superficial foreign bodies or taking a culture of the surface of the cornea or conjunctiva

glaucoma_treatment_authorized.quote: A licensed practitioner diagnosing angle closure, infantile, or congenital forms of glaucoma shall refer the patient to a physician skilled in diseases of the eye and licensed under chapter 458 or chapter 459

anaphylaxis_treatment_authorized.quote: a certified optometrist is permitted to use commonly accepted means or methods to immediately address incidents of anaphylaxis

vision_therapy_authorized.quote: the prescribing and employment of lenses, prisms, frames, mountings, contact lenses, orthoptic exercises, light frequencies, and any other means or methods, including ocular pharmaceutical agents, for the correction, remedy, or relief of any insufficiencies or abnormal conditions of the human eyes and their appendages

controlled_substance_schedule_restrictio.quote: A certified optometrist may not administer or prescribe: A controlled substance listed in Schedule III, Schedule IV, or Schedule V of s. 893.03, except for an oral analgesic placed on the formulary pursuant to this section for the relief of pain due to ocular conditions of the eye and its appendages

opioid_prescription_day_limit.quote: The following analgesics or their generic or therapeutic equivalents, which may not be administered or prescribed for more than 72 hours without consultation with a physician licensed under chapter 458 or chapter 459 who is skilled in diseases of the eye

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: Before a certified optometrist may administer or prescribe oral ocular pharmaceutical agents, the certified optometrist must provide proof to the department of successful completion of a course and subsequent examination, approved by the board, on general and ocular pharmaceutical agents and the side effects of those agents

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: Before a certified optometrist may administer or prescribe oral ocular pharmaceutical agents, the certified optometrist must provide proof to the department of successful completion of a course and subsequent examination, approved by the board, on general and ocular pharmaceutical agents and the side effects of those agents. The course shall consist of 20 contact hours

tiered_license_types.quote: "Licensed practitioner" means a person who is a primary health care provider licensed to engage in the practice of optometry under the authority of this chapter... "Certified optometrist" means a licensed practitioner authorized by the board to administer and prescribe ocular pharmaceutical agents.

pharmacology_training_hours_required.quote: Has successfully completed at least 110 hours of transcript-quality coursework and clinical training in general and ocular pharmacology as determined by the board

supervised_clinical_internship_required.quote: Has completed at least 1 year of supervised experience in differential diagnosis of eye disease or disorders as part of the optometric training or in a clinical setting as part of the optometric experience

referral_to_physician_required.quote: A licensed practitioner shall advise or assist her or his patient in obtaining further care when the service of another health care practitioner is required

comanagement_with_ophthalmologist_requir.quote: Co-management of postoperative care shall be conducted pursuant to the requirements of this section and a patient-specific transfer of care letter that governs the relationship between the physician who performed the surgery and the licensed practitioner

delegation_to_unlicensed_assistants_auth.quote: such personnel may perform data gathering, preliminary testing, prescribed visual therapy, and related duties under the direct supervision of the licensed practitioner. Nonlicensed personnel, who need not be employees of the licensed practitioner, may perform ministerial duties, tasks, and functions assigned to them by and performed under the general supervision of a licensed practitioner

contact_lens_prescription_expiration_yea.quote: A licensed practitioner shall make available to the patient or her or his agent any daily wear soft contact lens prescription or duplicate copy determined for that patient. Such prescription shall be considered a valid prescription to be filled for a period of 2 years

spectacle_prescription_release_required.quote: A licensed practitioner shall make available to the patient or her or his agent any spectacle prescription or duplicate copy determined for that patient

patient_record_retention_years.quote: A licensed practitioner shall keep on file for a period of at least 2 years any prescription she or he writes

limited_teaching_license_available.quote: The department may issue an optometric faculty certificate without examination to an individual who remits a nonrefundable application fee, not to exceed $100 plus the actual per applicant cost to the department, and who demonstrates to the board that she or he meets the following requirements

criminal_background_check_required.quote: Any person desiring to be a licensed practitioner under this chapter must apply to the department, submit to background screening in accordance with s. 456.0135
